2608.24231.title: RecurSE: Bounded Recursive Self-Evaluation for LLM Rubric Judges
2608.24231.paper_summary: LLM-as-judge is essential for evaluating open-ended text and steering post-training, yet improving the judge itself typically relies on expensive annotations, reward models, or distillation from stronger teachers. In this work, we eliminate external gold supervision from the RL training reward: the model's own evaluative capability generates learning signals for its optimization -- a closed-loop setting of bounded recursive self-improvement (RSI) termed Recursive Self-Evaluation (RecurSE). We study two central questions: when can self-improvement occur, and when must it stop? First, RecurSE pairs a trainable judge evaluating candidate responses under per-rule rubrics (Pass 1) with a synchronized policy-copy checker that audits the judge's reasoning against meta-rubrics to supply a scalar process reward (Pass 2). To enable learning, interface decoupling structurally isolates the checker's scalar score from the judge's verdict tokens, eliminating a degenerative token-copying shortcut that inflates self-assigned rewards. Second, because unanchored recursive learning is inherently bounded, Pairwise Advantage Validity (PAV) serves as an unbiased validation monitor that jointly tracks judge accuracy and checker fidelity to reliably identify the optimal early-stopping window. Across Qwen3.5-9B, Gemma-4-E4B-it, and Qwen3.6-27B, RecurSE achieves consistent generalization gains across held-out medical, pairwise, summarization, and professional benchmarks. Ablations demonstrate that synchronized judge-checker co-evolution outperforms frozen checkers, external meta-judges, self-consistency, and scaled teacher distillation. Furthermore, preference pairs curated by our judge effectively enhance downstream policy alignment. Bounded RSI for LLM-as-judge is thus viable when self-produced reward validity is explicitly decoupled and monitored.
2608.24231.paper_summary_zh: LLM-as-judge 對於評估開放式文本和引導後訓練至關重要，但改善評判者本身通常依賴於昂貴的標註、獎勵模型或來自更強教師的蒸餾。在這項工作中，我們消除了來自 RL 訓練獎勵的外部金標監督：模型自身的評估能力生成學習信號以進行優化——這是一種有界的遞歸自我改進（RSI）閉環設置，稱為遞歸自我評估（RecurSE）。我們研究了兩個核心問題：自我改進何時可以發生，何時必須停止？首先，RecurSE 將可訓練的評判者與根據每條規則的標準評估候選響應（第一階段）相配對，並與一個同步的策略複製檢查器協同工作，該檢查器根據元標準審核評判者的推理，以提供標量過程獎勵（第二階段）。為了促進學習，介面解耦在結構上將檢查器的標量分數與評判者的裁決標記隔離，消除了膨脹自我分配獎勵的退化標記複製捷徑。其次，由於未固定的遞歸學習本質上是有界的，成對優勢有效性（PAV）作為一個無偏的驗證監控器，聯合跟踪評判者的準確性和檢查器的忠實性，以可靠識別最佳的早停窗口。在 Qwen3.5-9B、Gemma-4-E4B-it 和 Qwen3.6-27B 中，RecurSE 在保留的醫療、成對、摘要和專業基準上實現了一致的泛化增益。消融實驗表明，同步的評判者-檢查器共同演化優於凍結檢查器、外部元評判者、自我一致性和擴展教師蒸餾。此外，我們的評判者精心策劃的偏好對有效增強下游政策對齊。因此，當自我產生的獎勵有效性明確解耦和監控時，LLM-as-judge 的有界 RSI 是可行的。
